scenario: A pnpm monorepo intentionally resolves workspace packages and npm aliases through committed workspace and lockfile evidence.
controls: pnpm-workspace.yaml declares apps and packages roots
pnpm-lock.yaml resolves @acme/ui to a local directory
npm alias left-pad resolves to @acme/left-pad-safe with integrity metadata
review_notes: workspace:* is not a missing public package
alias target is normalized before CVE and license lookup
